description: This file is a shell script that provides an API for managing system services using procd, including functions for opening and closing services and instances, setting parameters, handling triggers, and interacting with ubus. It is part of a system initialization and service management framework in OpenWrt.

methods.name: procd_open_service
methods.description: Initializes a new service with a given name and optional script, preparing for further configuration.

methods.name: procd_close_service
methods.description: Finalizes and sends the accumulated service configuration to the system via ubus.

methods.name: procd_open_instance
methods.description: Starts the configuration of a new service instance.

methods.name: procd_close_instance
methods.description: Completes instance configuration and adds respawn parameters if necessary.

methods.name: procd_set_param
methods.description: Sets a parameter of a specific type for a service or instance.

methods.name: procd_append_param
methods.description: Appends additional data to an existing parameter.

methods.name: procd_running
methods.description: Checks if a given service or instance is currently running.

methods.name: procd_kill
methods.description: Kills a specified service or instance.

methods.name: procd_send_signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to a service or instance.

methods.name: procd_status
methods.description: Reports the current status of a service or instance.

methods.name: procd_add_mdns
methods.description: Adds mDNS data related to a service.

methods.name: uci_load_validate
methods.description: Validates UCI configuration and optionally calls a custom function.
